prompt.description: The prompt to send to Bing AI Mode. Bing puts the prompt in the page URL, so the limit is 3,500 characters after URL encoding. A letter, digit or space counts as 1, most punctuation as 3, an accented or Cyrillic letter as 6, and a Chinese, Japanese or Korean character as 9. Thus a CJK prompt can have a maximum of 388 characters. A longer prompt returns a 400 error: "Prompt is too long (max 3,500 characters, fewer for non-Latin scripts)".

legacy.description: Serve ChatGPT's legacy desktop interface instead of the default mobile-web one. The legacy interface streams the answer as an event stream, so `result.model`, `result.searchQueries` and `result.mapSearchQueries` are populated. ChatGPT shows ads far more often on this interface. Best-effort and temporary: OpenAI controls which interface it serves and can retire the legacy one at any time, so a request can still come back in the mobile-web shape. Handle both.
